method_definitions.IF2: Custom IF2 using native PyDPF ParticleFilter
method_definitions.IFAD: Custom IF2 and discounted resampling alpha .97 with torch.optim.Adam
method_definitions.ADPF: Native PyDPF StopGradientDPF with torch.optim.Adam, direct from original starts

IF2.accounting_note: 12 rows ran in one batch; batch fitting time is charged once, not 12 times. Scoring process wall already includes its preparation/compilation/execution. Allocation residual includes process imports, modules, environment checks, hashing and I/O; it is not pure scoring time.

IFAD.accounting_note: 12 rows start together; 11 continue after the row11 failure. Count unique batch fitting once, including full IF2 prefix and the failed attempt. Never multiply batch cost by12. Score process wall includes preparation/compilation/execution; residual allocation includes imports/checks/I/O.

ADPF.accounting_note: Unique batch cost once. Saved score process wall already includes preparation/compilation/execution. Failed calls remain charged; residual allocation is not pure score time.

timing_scope: Actual unique batch times, not per-row multiplied times. All three use one A40 on different nodes. Fixed iteration configurations are not equal-time budgets. IFAD includes its complete IF2 prefix and failed attempt.

IF2.definition: IFAD minus comparison; complete sufficiently precise nonsaturated pairs only

ADPF.definition: IFAD minus comparison; complete sufficiently precise nonsaturated pairs only

randomness_audit.training_streams: Distinct method/stage torch seeds; batch member draws use shared generators.
randomness_audit.evaluation_streams: Independent original PyPOMP PF, method/row/batch SeedSequence streams; no training objectives used.

precision_note: Floor-saturated scores can pass MCSE/ESS mechanically. Such rows remain flagged and cannot count as usable completed fits. Complete-fit medians are conditional and reported alongside full retained medians and failure counts.
provenance_note: Original runtime did not write terminal_manifest.json. Per-method completed-state read-only SHA collections were independently verified; IFAD/ADPF include explicit pre/post archive checks.
limitations: IFAD failed row11 retains last accepted parameters and status, but its Adam moments were removed from the active optimizer. The final Adam checkpoint has only11 surviving rows.
Numerical precision at a constant observation floor does not imply a valid completed fit.
